items.title: Form LLC or Corporation
items.desc: Register business entity. LLC recommended for liability protection + tax flexibility. File in your state or Delaware/Wyoming.

items.title: Get EIN (Employer Identification Number)
items.desc: Apply at IRS.gov — instant online. Needed for bank accounts, taxes, Apple Developer.

items.title: Open business bank account
items.desc: Separate personal and business finances. Needed before accepting payments.

items.title: Get DUNS Number
items.desc: Required for Apple Developer enrollment. Apply at dnb.com — free but slow.

items.title: Business Insurance (E&O + General Liability)
items.desc: Protects against lawsuits from AI output, data breaches, etc. E&O especially important for AI products.
items.note: Has existing insurance - review E&O coverage for AI product before launch

items.title: Draft Privacy Policy
items.desc: MUST name Anthropic as AI data processor. Must cover GDPR, CCPA, data collection, usage, sharing, retention, user rights.

items.title: Draft Terms of Service
items.desc: Include AI output disclaimer, liability limitation, acceptable use, DMCA, dispute resolution, arbitration clause.

items.title: Draft Acceptable Use Policy
items.desc: What users can/cannot do with AI agents. Important for Anthropic compliance and App Store.

items.title: AI Output Disclaimer
items.desc: Clear disclosure that AI can make mistakes. Required by CA AI Transparency Act SB 942 (Jan 2026).

items.title: EULA (End User License Agreement)
items.desc: Required for App Store. Covers software licensing, restrictions, warranty disclaimer.

items.title: Refund Policy
items.desc: App Store/Play Store handle refunds for IAP. For direct: Stripe handles disputes. Document your policy.

items.title: Apple Developer Program enrollment
items.desc: Requires DUNS number for organizations. $99/yr. Gives access to App Store Connect, TestFlight.

items.title: Build Guideline 5.1.2(i) consent flow
items.desc: CRITICAL for AI apps. Must: name Anthropic explicitly, explain what data is sent and why, get EXPLICIT opt-in consent BEFORE first API call. Build this BEFORE submitting.

items.title: Complete Privacy Nutrition Labels
items.desc: Declare all data collected, linked, and tracked. AI apps typically: usage data, identifiers, user content. Must be accurate or face rejection.

items.title: Implement App Tracking Transparency (ATT)
items.desc: If using any third-party analytics/ads that track: must show ATT prompt. If no tracking, declare in privacy labels.

items.title: Set up App Store Connect listing
items.desc: Screenshots (6.5" + 5.5"), app description, keywords, categories, age rating, pricing.

items.title: TestFlight beta testing
items.desc: Internal (25 testers, no review) + External (10K testers, requires Beta App Review). Test for 2-4 weeks minimum.

items.title: App Review submission
items.desc: Average review: 24-48 hours. First submission can take longer. Common rejections: missing privacy policy link, incomplete functionality, guideline 5.1.2(i) issues.

items.title: In-App Purchase setup (if using Apple IAP)
items.desc: REQUIRED for digital goods/subscriptions consumed in-app. Can use Stripe for SaaS accessed via web. Apple takes 30% (15% for Small Business Program < $1M).

items.title: Apply for Small Business Program
items.desc: If revenue under $1M/yr: commission drops from 30% to 15%. Apply in App Store Connect.

items.title: Google Play Developer Account
items.desc: $25 one-time fee. Requires Google account. As of 2026, identity verification is required globally.

items.title: Developer identity verification
items.desc: Google requires D-U-N-S for orgs, government ID for individuals. Global rollout by Sept 2026.

items.title: Complete Data Safety section
items.desc: Declare all data collected, shared, security practices. Must be accurate. Google reviews and can suspend.

items.title: AI-generated content disclosure
items.desc: Google Play requires apps to disclose AI-generated content clearly. Must label AI outputs.

items.title: Implement in-app account deletion
items.desc: REQUIRED by Google Play policy. Users must be able to delete their account from within the app.

items.title: Content rating (IARC questionnaire)
items.desc: Complete IARC questionnaire in Play Console. Determines age rating. Required before publishing.

items.title: Closed + Open testing tracks
items.desc: Closed testing (invite-only), then open testing (public beta). Minimum 20 testers for 14 days before production.

items.title: macOS: Code signing certificate (Developer ID)
items.desc: Part of Apple Developer Program ($99/yr). Required for notarization. Without it: Gatekeeper blocks app.

items.title: macOS: Notarization
items.desc: Submit app to Apple for malware scan. Required for Gatekeeper to allow opening. Automated via xcrun notarytool.

items.title: Windows: Code signing certificate
items.desc: Azure Trusted Signing or third-party CA. Without it: SmartScreen warning blocks most users from installing.

items.title: Build auto-update mechanism
items.desc: Tauri has built-in updater. Electron-builder has autoUpdater. Critical for security patches.

items.title: Create installers (DMG + MSI/NSIS)
items.desc: macOS: DMG with app drag-to-Applications. Windows: NSIS or MSI installer. Tauri generates both.

items.title: GDPR compliance (EU)
items.desc: If serving EU users: lawful basis, data processing agreements, right to erasure, data portability, DPO if needed. Fines up to 4% global revenue.

items.title: CCPA/CPRA compliance (California)
items.desc: If serving CA users: right to know, delete, opt-out of sale. Must respond within 45 days. Privacy policy must disclose.

items.title: California AI Transparency Act (SB 942)
items.desc: Effective Jan 2026. AI systems must: clearly disclose AI-generated content, provide opt-out mechanisms, maintain transparency. ALREADY IN EFFECT.

items.title: EU AI Act transparency obligations
items.desc: Effective Aug 2026. AI systems must: disclose AI nature, provide human oversight option, document training data. TinyPM likely 'limited risk' category.

items.title: COPPA compliance (children's data)
items.desc: If ANY users might be under 13: must get verifiable parental consent or block children. Safest: restrict to 13+ in App Store age rating.

items.title: Anthropic API Terms compliance
items.desc: Review and comply with Anthropic's Acceptable Use Policy. Ensure TinyPM doesn't violate any prohibited uses.

items.title: Stripe account setup
items.desc: For web/desktop payments (not in-app mobile). Requires business info, bank account, tax ID.

items.title: Stripe Tax setup
items.desc: Auto-calculate and collect sales tax. Required in states where you have nexus. Alternative: Avalara.

items.title: Subscription billing implementation
items.desc: Stripe Billing for recurring subscriptions. Set up products, prices, customer portal, webhooks.

items.title: Apple IAP integration (if mobile)
items.desc: Required for digital goods in iOS app. Apple handles billing, you handle entitlements. StoreKit 2 framework.

items.title: Google Play Billing (if mobile)
items.desc: Required for digital goods in Android app. Google handles billing. Uses Google Play Billing Library.

items.title: Trademark search for 'TinyPM'
items.desc: Search USPTO TESS database for conflicts. Also search internationally if selling globally.

items.title: File trademark application
items.desc: File with USPTO. Classes 9 (software) and 42 (SaaS). Takes 8-12 months to register.

items.title: Open source license audit
items.desc: Check all dependencies for GPL/AGPL (viral) licenses that could require open-sourcing your code.

items.title: SSL/TLS certificates
items.desc: Let's Encrypt (free) or paid CA. Required for HTTPS. Supabase includes SSL.

items.title: Data encryption at rest and in transit
items.desc: TLS 1.3 for transit. AES-256 for stored data. Supabase handles database encryption.

items.title: Authentication system (OAuth 2.0)
items.desc: Supabase Auth built-in. Google/Apple/Email sign-in. Required for App Store (Sign in with Apple mandate).

items.title: Rate limiting
items.desc: Protect API from abuse. Especially important for AI endpoints (each call costs money).

items.title: Incident response plan
items.desc: Document: who to contact, how to respond, notification timelines. GDPR requires 72-hour breach notification.

items.title: Backup strategy
items.desc: Supabase includes daily backups on Pro plan. Set up additional backups for critical data.

items.title: CAN-SPAM compliance for email marketing
items.desc: Every marketing email must: include physical address, unsubscribe link, honor opt-outs within 10 days.

items.title: FTC endorsement/testimonial guidelines
items.desc: Disclose material connections with reviewers. Don't fake testimonials. AI-generated reviews must be disclosed.

items.title: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance
items.desc: Color contrast, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, alt text. Required for government/enterprise sales. ADA lawsuits increasing.

items.title: Bookkeeping setup (QuickBooks/Xero)
items.desc: Track revenue, expenses, app store commissions. Needed for taxes and investor reporting.

items.title: Quarterly estimated tax payments
items.desc: IRS requires quarterly payments if you'll owe $1000+. Form 1040-ES. Penalties for underpayment.

items.title: Sales tax registration + filing
items.desc: Register in states where you have nexus. File monthly/quarterly. Stripe Tax automates collection.
